records.context: Score profiles by mechanism of action, leaving one compound out.
records.label: spacr.moa_benchmark#0
records.source: Score profiles by mechanism of action, leaving one compound out.
records.translation: Évalue des profils par mécanisme d’action, en laissant un composé de côté.

records.context: A profiling result is comparable with the published BBBC021 numbers (Ljosa et al. 2013) only when it is scored the same way. This module is spaCR's one scorer for that: every arm holds out a whole compound, so a treatment is never matched to, or trained on, the same compound at another concentration.
records.label: spacr.moa_benchmark#1
records.source: A profiling result is comparable with the published BBBC021 numbers (Ljosa et al. 2013) only when it is scored the same way. This module is spaCR's one scorer for that: every arm holds out a whole compound, so a treatment is never matched to, or trained on, the same compound at another concentration.
records.translation: Un résultat de profilage n’est comparable aux chiffres publiés de BBBC021 (Ljosa et al. 2013) que s’il est évalué de la même manière. Ce module est l’unique évaluateur de spaCR à cet effet : chaque bras met de côté un composé entier, de sorte qu’un traitement n’est jamais apparié au même composé à une autre concentration, ni entraîné sur celui-ci.

records.context: Everything executes on the CPU; ``workers`` fits that many folds at a time in independent execution paths of one process.
records.label: spacr.moa_benchmark#10
records.source: Everything runs on the CPU; ``workers`` fits that many folds at a time in threads of one process.
records.translation: Tout s’exécute sur le CPU ; ``workers`` ajuste autant de plis à la fois dans des threads d’un seul processus.

records.context: :func:`loco_nearest_neighbour` is the unsupervised arm: one nearest neighbour (1-NN) by cosine similarity between treatment profiles, under NSC (not same compound) and NSCB (not same compound or batch). It is :func:`spacr.embeddings.evaluate_moa`, so both give the same numbers.
records.label: spacr.moa_benchmark#2
records.source: :func:`loco_nearest_neighbour` is the unsupervised arm: one nearest neighbour (1-NN) by cosine similarity between treatment profiles, under NSC (not same compound) and NSCB (not same compound or batch). It is :func:`spacr.embeddings.evaluate_moa`, so both give the same numbers.
records.translation: :func:`loco_nearest_neighbour` est le bras non supervisé : un seul plus proche voisin (1-NN) par similarité cosinus entre profils de traitement, avec NSC (pas le même composé) et NSCB (pas le même composé ni le même lot). Il s’agit de :func:`spacr.embeddings.evaluate_moa`, si bien que les deux donnent les mêmes chiffres.

records.context: :func:`loco_supervised` trains a machine-learning classification model on the microplate sample positions of the other compounds and predicts the held-out compound's microplate sample positions: a standardised logistic regression or XGBoost, on the CPU. Under NSC there is one fold per compound; under NSCB one per treatment, and the training microplate sample positions also leave out every batch that treatment was imaged in.
records.label: spacr.moa_benchmark#3
records.source: :func:`loco_supervised` trains a classifier on the wells of the other compounds and predicts the held-out compound's wells: a standardised logistic regression or XGBoost, on the CPU. Under NSC there is one fold per compound; under NSCB one per treatment, and the training wells also leave out every batch that treatment was imaged in.
records.translation: :func:`loco_supervised` entraîne un classifieur sur les puits des autres composés et prédit les puits du composé mis de côté : une régression logistique standardisée ou XGBoost, sur le CPU. Avec NSC, il y a un pli par composé ; avec NSCB, un par traitement, et les puits d’entraînement excluent aussi chaque lot dans lequel ce traitement a été imagé.

records.context: :func:`shuffled_label_control` repeats any arm with the compound-to-MoA mapping shuffled, which gives the accuracy of chance; :func:`majority_class_control` gives the accuracy of always guessing the commonest MoA.
records.label: spacr.moa_benchmark#4
records.source: :func:`shuffled_label_control` repeats any arm with the compound-to-MoA mapping shuffled, which gives the accuracy of chance; :func:`majority_class_control` gives the accuracy of always guessing the commonest MoA.
records.translation: :func:`shuffled_label_control` répète n’importe quel bras avec la correspondance composé-MoA permutée, ce qui donne la précision du hasard ; :func:`majority_class_control` donne la précision obtenue en devinant toujours le MoA le plus fréquent.

records.source: :func:`moa_benchmark` runs the arms and the controls on one table and returns one accuracy table with a glossary; :func:`write_moa_benchmark` writes them through :func:`spacr.tabular.write_table`.
records.translation: :func:`moa_benchmark` exécute les bras et les témoins sur une table et renvoie une table de précision accompagnée d’un glossaire ; :func:`write_moa_benchmark` les écrit via :func:`spacr.tabular.write_table`.

records.context: Input is a table of per-microplate sample position profiles (normalised to the laboratory microplate's control microplate sample positions, one row per microplate sample position) or of per-treatment profiles (one row per treatment), with a MoA column, a compound column, the columns that name a treatment and, for NSCB, a batch column. Per-microplate sample position input is combined per treatment by ``replicates`` (the median, as Ljosa et al. 2013) for the 1-NN arm, and used as it is by the supervised arms.
records.label: spacr.moa_benchmark#7
records.source: Input is a table of per-well profiles (normalised to the plate's control wells, one row per well) or of per-treatment profiles (one row per treatment), with a MoA column, a compound column, the columns that name a treatment and, for NSCB, a batch column. Per-well input is combined per treatment by ``replicates`` (the median, as Ljosa et al. 2013) for the 1-NN arm, and used as it is by the supervised arms.
records.translation: L’entrée est une table de profils par puits (normalisés sur les puits témoins de la plaque, une ligne par puits) ou de profils par traitement (une ligne par traitement), avec une colonne MoA, une colonne composé, les colonnes qui désignent un traitement et, pour NSCB, une colonne lot. L’entrée par puits est combinée par traitement selon ``replicates`` (la médiane, comme Ljosa et al. 2013) pour le bras 1-NN, et utilisée telle quelle par les bras supervisés.

records.context: Under NSC each compound is held out in turn (all its concentrations and replicate microplate sample positions) and a machine-learning classification model is trained on the microplate sample positions of every other compound. Under NSCB each treatment is held out in turn, and the training microplate sample positions also leave out every microplate sample position imaged in a batch of that treatment (a compound imaged in every batch would otherwise leave nothing to train on). A treatment's prediction is the class with the highest mean probability over its microplate sample positions. A fold whose training microplate sample positions hold fewer than two classes is not scored.
records.label: spacr.moa_benchmark.loco_supervised#1
records.source: Under NSC each compound is held out in turn (all its concentrations and replicate wells) and a classifier is trained on the wells of every other compound. Under NSCB each treatment is held out in turn, and the training wells also leave out every well imaged in a batch of that treatment (a compound imaged in every batch would otherwise leave nothing to train on). A treatment's prediction is the class with the highest mean probability over its wells. A fold whose training wells hold fewer than two classes is not scored.
records.translation: Avec NSC, chaque composé est mis de côté à tour de rôle (toutes ses concentrations et tous ses puits réplicats) et un classifieur est entraîné sur les puits de tous les autres composés. Avec NSCB, chaque traitement est mis de côté à tour de rôle, et les puits d’entraînement excluent aussi tout puits imagé dans un lot de ce traitement (sinon, un composé imagé dans tous les lots ne laisserait rien pour l’entraînement). La prédiction d’un traitement est la classe de plus forte probabilité moyenne sur ses puits. Un pli dont les puits d’entraînement contiennent moins de deux classes n’est pas évalué.

records.context: The supervised arms are close to, not identical with, the BBBC021 reanalysis (``supervised_moa.py``, CellProfiler microplate sample positions, Ljosa scaling, microplate sample position means): logistic regression gives 96/103 under NSC (96 in the reference) and 68/102 under NSCB (67); XGBoost 91/103 under NSC (88) and 63/102 under NSCB (64). The folds and parameters are the same; the differences are numerical, most likely library versions (scikit-learn, XGBoost, BLAS) and execution concurrency (the reference fitted 6 processes of 2 independent execution paths). The 1-NN arm reproduces ``run_and_score.py`` exactly.
records.label: spacr.moa_benchmark.loco_supervised#4
records.source: The supervised arms are close to, not identical with, the BBBC021 reanalysis (``supervised_moa.py``, CellProfiler wells, Ljosa scaling, well means): logistic regression gives 96/103 under NSC (96 in the reference) and 68/102 under NSCB (67); XGBoost 91/103 under NSC (88) and 63/102 under NSCB (64). The folds and parameters are the same; the differences are numerical, most likely library versions (scikit-learn, XGBoost, BLAS) and threading (the reference fitted 6 processes of 2 threads). The 1-NN arm reproduces ``run_and_score.py`` exactly.
records.translation: Les bras supervisés sont proches de la réanalyse de BBBC021 (``supervised_moa.py``, puits CellProfiler, mise à l’échelle de Ljosa, moyennes par puits), sans lui être identiques : la régression logistique donne 96/103 avec NSC (96 dans la référence) et 68/102 avec NSCB (67) ; XGBoost 91/103 avec NSC (88) et 63/102 avec NSCB (64). Les plis et les paramètres sont les mêmes ; les différences sont numériques, très probablement dues aux versions des bibliothèques (scikit-learn, XGBoost, BLAS) et au multithreading (la référence a ajusté 6 processus de 2 threads). Le bras 1-NN reproduit exactement ``run_and_score.py``.

records.context: The compound-to-MoA mapping is permuted (each compound keeps one MoA, so the class sizes stay as they are) and the arm is scored again, once per permutation; NSC and NSCB are scored on the same permutation. The mean is what chance alone gives: an arm that does not clear it has learned nothing about MoA. A compound with two MoA labels makes the shuffle permute the rows instead.
records.label: spacr.moa_benchmark.shuffled_label_control#1
records.source: The compound-to-MoA mapping is permuted (each compound keeps one MoA, so the class sizes stay as they are) and the arm is scored again, once per permutation; NSC and NSCB are scored on the same permutation. The mean is what chance alone gives: an arm that does not clear it has learned nothing about MoA. A compound with two MoA labels makes the shuffle permute the rows instead.
records.translation: La correspondance composé-MoA est permutée (chaque composé garde un seul MoA, donc les effectifs des classes restent inchangés) et le bras est réévalué, une fois par permutation ; NSC et NSCB sont évalués sur la même permutation. La moyenne correspond à ce que donne le seul hasard : un bras qui ne la dépasse pas n’a rien appris sur le MoA. Un composé portant deux étiquettes MoA conduit la permutation à permuter plutôt les lignes.
